+import { host, linkedHosts } from "@vitadeck/sdk/host-control";
+
+const reply = await host.echo({ text: "hi" });
+if (reply.ok) console.log(reply.text);
+else if (reply.code === "not_linked") setHint("Link a computer in the VitaDeck Shell");
